resolution.note: area() names top-level dirs root:<dir>; regression test added; FR-40 manifest refrozen

title: Separate top-level evals/ from the src/evals layer in the boundary check
body:
scripts/boundaries.ts area() names both src/evals and the top-level evals/ directory "evals", so a LAYERS entry 'evals' silently allows imports of evals/ experiment files too (found while wiring src/brain, which had to use the exact file entry evals/fr40/tasks.ts instead).
Acceptance: area() distinguishes top-level directories from src areas (for example by a leading './' or 'root:' prefix), test/import-boundary.test.ts has a case where an area allowed 'evals' importing evals/fr40/tasks.ts is a violation, and the existing layer map still passes.
